create_eval_with_litellm: create an evaluation with litellm using a stored completions data source and label model testing criteria
list_evals_with_litellm: list evaluations from an LLM provider using litellm list_evals with a limit parameter
get_eval_by_id: get a specific evaluation by its ID using litellm get_eval for a given provider
update_eval_name: update an existing evaluation name using litellm update_eval with the eval ID and new name
test_openai_evals_api: test the OpenAI Evals API by subclassing BaseEvalsAPITest and providing an OpenAI API key
